remix by {{player|bps|flag=se}} |gametype=1on1, 2on2, FFA |size=Small |family=[[TB5]] remake |download=https://maps.quakeworld.nu/all/dm4frost.bsp }} Cosmetically modified version of '''The Bad Place''' better known as [[Dm4]] - one of the six deathmatch maps included with Quake. One of five maps in a ''"[[TB5]]-frost"'' map pack intended for release in conjunction with [[Sdcup5]], remixed by {{player|bps|flag=se}}. See also [[dm2frost]], [[dm6frost]], [[ztndm3frost]] and [[aerowalkfrost]]. {{MapItems |quad=1 |ring= |pent= |hp100=1 |ra=1 |ya=1 |ga=2 |lg=1 |rl=2 |gl=1 |sng=1 |ng=1 |ssg=1 }} == Gameplay changes== As lava has frozen, this opens up for a new gameplay and meta around the big room floor, and to some degree [[MH]] room aswell. There are ways out of the fluff without rocket jumping, but they're not very simple to execute. ===Hidden spot below bridge=== When passing underneath low bridge, wading through the fluffy snow, you're invisible from above. Have this new spot in mind as you walk the bridge, or get ready for a nasty surprise. [[Category:Maps]]
